LanguageData.LP_TalentGifted.degreeDatas.colorB070E0c: [PAWN_nameDef] was born with more talent than others. The effect of each point of positive modifier in the six adventurer ability scores ×1.5 (takes the larger of this and racial affinity, not multiplied).
LanguageData.LP_TalentLateBloomer.degreeDatas.colorB0: [PAWN_nameDef] starts slowly but goes farther and farther. Gains 1 legend point every 4 adventurer levels; legend levels 21-40 give 3 legend points per level (normally 2).
LanguageData.LP_TalentTempered.degreeDatas.colorB070E: Every bit of [PAWN_nameDef]'s progress was hard-won. Each ability score improvement gives 3 points (+3 to one, or +2 to one and +1 to another), with one more improvement at level 20.
LanguageData.LP_TalentMortalWill.degreeDatas.colorB07: [PAWN_nameDef] has no illustrious bloodline, only a will that refuses to give up. Adventurer XP +25%; every legend attribute point is worth ×1.5 (takes the larger of this and racial affinity, not multiplied).
